label: The embedder route is three delete-whole objects: the route block at _routes.yaml 232 to 249, the 180-line workflow asset doctor-skill-advisor-embedder.yaml, and the cost script measure-embedder-cost.mjs, which the asset names at line 44 and which has no other caller. /doctor:skill-advisor is left with six targets.

The skill-advisor router doc and presentation carry the route in seven places: skill-advisor.md 3 (argument-hint) and 61 (table row); doctor-skill-advisor-presentation.txt 16 (menu item 5), 31 (mapping), 65 (valid targets), 87 (route row) and section 8 from 207 to the end at 306. Menu items after 5 renumber; those lines were not read.

/doctor:setup runs an embedder leg at doctor-setup.yaml 60; its presentation carries it at 40, 55, 64 and 108; setup.md 62 says seven read-only legs and names the embedder check. After removal there are six legs (sk-code, sk-git, trigger-index, runtime-mirrors, advisor, delivery). The setup contract test asserts neither the leg nor the count.

/doctor:install step 5 is the embedder (doctor-install.yaml 60, doctor-install-presentation.txt 122 to 123), and doctor-install-contract.test.cjs 87 to 92 lists it in CHECKLIST_STEPS, where checklistOwner (101 to 106) resolves every step to a manifest route. The route block, the asset, the presentation and the test entry must change in one commit; /doctor:setup becomes step 5.

Five workflows print an informational vector coverage line from one advisor_status --include-semantic-health call: doctor-update-apply.yaml 212 (presentation 429, 467, 471), doctor-overlay-apply.yaml 124 (presentation 427, 438, 451, 463), doctor-overlay-repin.yaml 114 (presentation 489, 501), doctor-symlink-link.yaml 102 (presentation 217, 252). All are deleted; update presentation 429 and 471 are reworded. No contract test pins them and the symlink and overlay engines contain no lane code.

AdvisorStatusInputSchema is strict (advisor-tool-schemas.ts 381 to 393) and declares includeSemanticHealth at 385, so a doctor step that still passes --include-semantic-health after the key is removed is refused, not ignored. Seven doctor files pass the flag. The doctor edits land in the same commit as the flag removal or before it. The refusal is inferred from the strict schema; the CLI flag mapping was not read. includeEmbeddingsHealth (386, handler 583) is a second lane-only diagnostic that no doctor file passes.

skill-advisor-route-contract.test.cjs loses its constants at 74 to 81, the helpers embedderRoute (193) and embedderWorkflow (202), and section 4 from 326 to the end of the file at 496 (six tests). Sections 1 to 3 survive, and skill_graph_scan stays required because _routes.yaml 125 and 147 still declare it. Unconfirmed: whether advisor_status stays declared on a skill-advisor route once line 240 is gone.

The command bridge artifacts are generated from _routes.yaml by derive-command-bridges.cjs (input at 25, output path at 27, writes at 1385 and 1388, --check mode at 1312). The embedder bridge appears in command-bridges.generated.json from 1634, the generated block of projection.ts (row at 768), the generated rows of command-attach.ts (97 and 166) and skill_advisor.py 2737 to 2740. They are regenerated after the route block is deleted, not hand-edited. scoring-compatibility.json names the bridge at 266 and 611; whether it is a generator input or output was not read.

orphan-process-check.cjs classifies the HF model server (constant at 24 to 27, branch at 232 to 246, kinds stale-model-server and unsupervised-model-server). Dependent text: its test (76 to 101, 197 to 211, 224 to 268, 308), scripts README 130, setup.md 72, setup presentation 87 (SPECKIT_HF_MODEL_SERVER_ORPHAN_REAP), the /doctor:setup trigger phrase at _routes.yaml 407, and helper fixtures tune.jsonl 60 and heldout.jsonl 48, the latter pinned by a SHA-256 at doctor-helper-match.test.cjs 44. The script survives for its other process kinds. The classifier is the only doctor match for a leftover server, so the user-machine cleanup needs its own process match or must run before the classifier is removed.

doctor-phrase-reach.cjs sets SKILL_ADVISOR_DISABLE_BUILTIN_SEMANTIC to 1 at line 169, with a comment at 163 saying semantic embeddings are disabled. Iteration 1 found no reader for the variable, so the assignment and the comment clause are remnants and the variable is in scope for removal.

The runtime mirrors need no hand edit. The 17 doctor entries in .claude/commands/doctor and in .cursor/commands, and the one .opencode/commands/doctor entry, are tracked symlinks (mode 120000) into .skilled. The 17 real doctor files each in .codex/prompts, .pi/prompts and .vibe/prompts have no lane match. The gate is sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs --check, already a /doctor:setup leg at doctor-setup.yaml 58.

The embedder route can have left three things on a user machine: one pulled nomic-embed-text:v1.5 in the Ollama model store (asset line 71), a background ollama serve process with a log whose path and pid the workflow never persists (131), and vectors in skill-graph.sqlite (73). It never installs Ollama (166) and refuses non-local hosts (130). The model store is shared and nothing records that this route pulled the model, so the cleanup can detect the model but cannot prove ownership: removal of the model and of a running server should ask first.

References to the route outside the doctor folder: INSTALL-SKILLED.md 86 to 98, 157 and 342; advisor INSTALL-GUIDE.md 54 and 362; changelogs skilled v4.1.0.0 (210, 770), v4.2.0.0 (77), system-skilled-doctor v1.1.7.0 (47 to 49), system-skill-advisor v1.2.0.0 (3); feature catalog doctor-command-routing.md 31. The spec-kit trigger index (70806 to 70818, 113488) and phrase-variants fixture carry the phrase embedder setup and cost as spec packet triggers, so a repo-wide grep cannot reach zero unless specs/ and the indexes derived from it are excluded or historical packets are rewritten.

Three open checks from iteration 2. (1) shared/chunking.ts and shared/utils/retry.ts have no production importer outside the package, only tests, so they lose their last production consumer with it. (2) MEMORY_DB_PATH has no reader outside the package in the lines returned; its launcher setter block at 332 to 344 exists for the package and goes with it; SPEC_KIT_DB_DIR has other setters (worktree-session.sh 495) and stays open. (3) validate-doc-model-refs.js guards the registry read with existsSync (31), so a deleted registry gives an empty canonical set, which the file's own comment (41 to 42) says produces false-positive drift on every cited name; the validator goes in the same commit as the package.
The doctor workflow edits that drop --include-semantic-health must land in the same commit as, or before, the removal of includeSemanticHealth from the strict status input schema.

The embedder route block in _routes.yaml, the install checklist (asset, presentation) and the CHECKLIST_STEPS entry in doctor-install-contract.test.cjs change in one commit, because the test resolves every checklist step to a manifest route.
Generated bridge outputs are regenerated by derive-command-bridges.cjs after _routes.yaml changes and gated by its --check mode; they are never hand-edited.
A user-machine cleanup must not rely on the orphan process check to find a leftover hf-model-server once the classifier at orphan-process-check.cjs 232 to 246 is removed.
The residue check cannot be a bare repo-wide grep: the spec-kit trigger index mirrors historical spec packet trigger phrases that contain the word embedder.

Three items were left unread by budget: menu items after item 5 in the skill-advisor presentation, whether advisor_status stays declared on a skill-advisor route, and one loose-pattern match in release-update.cjs.
